test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the **ANTONYM **of the following word in the given sentence.

**Lethargy**

The usually circumspect personnel’s vigour for his duty was visible in his dealing with customers.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2) i.e. "Vigour".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lethargy: (सुस्ती)** - A lack of energy and enthusiasm.

 
 
• **Example**: Periods of weakness and lethargy sometimes follow the illness.
 
 
 
• **Vigour: (ऊर्जा)** - Physical strength and good health.
 
 
• **Example**: He was full of vigour and stamina.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Vigour".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Visible: (दृश्यमान) **- Able to be seen.
 
• **Circumspect: (सतर्क)** - Wary and unwilling to take risks. **Trick to remember** (Sir ka kam pe hamesha circumspect rahena hoga.)
 
• **Usually: (सामान्यतः) **- Under normal conditions.

15c:Tc75,

The correct answer is Option (4): Me
